name: TrustDemoIND02
title: TD.IND.02 Shared-link openings that were authorised
description: Of the requests to open a family member's shared link, the proportion the home country released.
guidance: A definition only: it states no target and no value. Data elements: TD.J41.DE01 Requested at; TD.J41.DE02 Requester; TD.J41.DE06 Released; TD.J41.DE08 Refusal reason. Decision tables: TD.DT.05. Requirements: STD-ACC-001. The populations are described, not computable: this guide carries no CQL.

population.description: Manifest requests in the reporting period, released or refused.

criteria.expression: COUNT of access records (TD.J41) WHERE "Requested at" is in the reporting period

population.description: Manifest requests in the reporting period that were released.

criteria.expression: COUNT of access records (TD.J41) WHERE "Requested at" is in the reporting period AND "Released" = true

stratifier.description: the receiver abroad, and its country
